instruction: Aim for a defensible novel speech/NLP research contribution that could support peer-reviewed publication in the ACL theme. Do not treat decoder reuse, spectral blending, larger models or longer runs alone as sufficient novelty.
priorities_retained: transfer and defense retention measured after source gate
evidence_plan: Nearest-prior-work audit, falsifiable mechanism, compute-fair baselines and ablations, held-out transfer/defense and human intelligibility before paper-level claims
